newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open mixed, trading at bottom end.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open mixed, trading at bottom end.

text.p: Mixed sentiment for Singapore shares on Tuesday offered no sign that the market's key index would move from the bottom of its current trading range in the near future, dealers said.
"The best we can hope for is that investors will buy on weakness," said one dealer at an international broking house.
Limited buying of key index stocks in early trade helped edge the Straits Times Industrials Index up 4.10 to 1,979.11 by 0300 GMT, but dealers detected no across the board buoyancy.
"We're at the lower end of our trading range and we're not about to move out of it," one dealer said.
Early activity saw gains for NatSteel, which briefly hit a high of Singapore $4.50, Cycle & Carriage and Fraser & Neave. Between them, the three accounted for the bulk of the rise in the index.
Venture Manufacturing, a steady riser since unveiling new multimedia software last week, corrected in the morning with a slip of S$0.40 to S$6.50.
Shares in competitor Creative Technology were suspended for the morning session after the announcement of its annual results in the U.S. overnight. They closed Monday down S$0.60 at S$33.90.
